title: Counit-normalized transport of a right adjoint along a source isomorphism
statement: For qcqs schemes P,U,S, qcqs f:P→S and f′:U→S, and e:U≅P with e.hom≫f=f′, choose right adjoints a,b with their specified adjunctions to the canonical lifted direct images. There is a natural isomorphism φ:a followed by the inclusion and L(e.hom) ≅ b followed by the inclusion. It satisfies SchemeIsoRightAdjointNormalized: let adj(k) be the pinned adjunction of def-pc-derived-base-change-map, c be the canonical pullback composition comparison for e.hom and f followed by the equality transport, and δ:Rf′≅Re⋙Rf be conjugateIsoEquiv adj(f′) (adj(f).comp adj(e.hom)) c. For every K, Rf(ηe(aK))≫δ.inv(L e(aK))≫Rf′(φK)≫εb(K)=εa(K). The normalization is an equality of ambient derived morphisms. This concerns one vertical map and contains no base change or second mate.

source.place: Tag 0ATR, composite adjunction and conjugate calculation; Tag 0D5S, canonical pullback composition

proof.text: Construct the equivalence Le using inverse pullback along e.inv and the canonical composition and identity comparisons. Its pinned right adjoint Re is an equivalence. Restrict Le⊣Re to QCoh by fully faithful inclusions. Conjugate c to obtain δ, and lift it into QCoh.

Reverse the restricted equivalence adjunction and compose with adja; transport its left functor along δ.symm. rightAdjointUniq against adjb gives φ. Its counit identity, preceded by Rf of the equivalence unit and δ.inv, reduces by cancellation to εa. Apply the full-subcategory inclusion; the restricted unit is the ambient pinned unit. This is the proved private normalized_comparison and the final inclusion rewrite.

proof_origin.note: Categorical specialization; normalized endpoint comparisons are proved in Lean, and the remaining square is isolated.
